svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Modular monolith on Cloud Run · Firestore state · Vertex AI (Gemini + Search) · Cloud Tasks reminders · English baseline · v0.8
Cloud Run · clients read-only in Firestore
Firebase Auth (Google OAuth), validated in app middleware · Load Balancer + Cloud Armor
every mutation is a validated command (§4)
ZIGOTA-SERVICE — single Cloud Run deploy, components as modules
TRACKER DATA CORE (no AI) + REMINDERS + SCHEDULED MESSAGES
re-times active only · txns + version + idempotency
Tier-1 priority unconditional · safety/clinical: KB only
KB Tier-1 — CLINICAL corpus: meds · procedures · D2 signs · contacts · in-memory
Dashboard — read-only projection: today's plan · progress · actions-needed (no AI commentary)
Provenance envelope — inline on every AI-derived record:

{ item_type, lifecycle, origin, produced_by(+versions), provenance(source: card_region|kb_entry_ids|web_datastore, citation, confidence) } · lifecycle has no escalated state — escalation is a safetyEvent referencing an item
oos-filter + D2 matcher + fail-closed safety-classifier = deterministic gates before any generation (non-SaMD boundary)
patient state → Firestore · curated reference → bundled · externally-governed (Tier-2) → Vertex AI Search · auditEvents is the sole write ledger; the patient-visible change log is a projection of it
live · crawl date on every citation
FIRESTORE — single source of truth, patient state only · /users/{uid}/cycles/{cycleId}/… · UID-scoped rules, clients read-only
· Load Balancer + Cloud Armor · Firebase Auth (Google OAuth, app-middleware validation) · Cloud Tasks + Scheduler (reminders) · Secret Manager
· Cloud Storage — scoped signed-URL upload, server-derived object id, GCP-default encryption (CMEK = production bar) · Cloud Logging — no payload bodies, DLP backstop
· Protocol Model + KB + KB vectors = curated reference, bundled in image (git-versioned, atomic deploy) · service-account least privilege, separate runtime identities
Tier-2 retrieval — only after a KB miss, never safety or clinical
